extra_vocab.en: a room with a toilet and a sink
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店、辦公室、住宅和設施公告。美式英文中 bathroom 也常指廁所；公共場所的指示牌多用 restroom。

example.en: The office bathrooms will be cleaned twice a day.
example.zh: 辦公室的洗手間一天會清潔兩次。

example.en: Customers may use the bathroom on the second floor.
example.zh: 顧客可以使用二樓的洗手間。

example.en: Let's take a short bathroom break before the next session.
example.zh: 下一場開始前，我們先休息一下上洗手間。

example.en: All rooms at this hotel have a private bathroom.
example.zh: 這間飯店的所有房間都有獨立衛浴。

examples.en: The bathroom in our room was clean and bright.
examples.zh: 我們房間的浴室乾淨又明亮。

examples.en: The bathroom on the first floor is closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 一樓的洗手間因整修而關閉。

examples.en: The apartment has two bedrooms and one bathroom.
examples.zh: 這間公寓有兩間臥室和一間浴室。

confusable.diff: bath 是「洗澡、浴缸」，bathroom 是放浴缸或馬桶的「房間」。

example.en: I would like a room with a bath, not just a shower.
example.zh: 我想要有浴缸的房間，而不是只有淋浴。

similar.diff: restroom 是公共場所（餐廳、辦公室、商場）較客氣的說法；bathroom 在家裡或飯店房間內更常用。

example.en: The restroom is next to the elevator on this floor.
example.zh: 這一層的洗手間在電梯旁邊。

similar.diff: toilet 原指馬桶，英式英文也指廁所；在美式商務場合較少直接使用。

example.en: The toilet in the lobby is out of order.
example.zh: 大廳的馬桶故障了。

example.en: The gym has a shower for staff who bike to work.
example.zh: 健身房為騎車上班的員工設有淋浴間。

example.en: Please wash your hands at the sink before you enter.
example.zh: 進入前請先在洗手台洗手。

example.en: The hotel provides clean towels every morning.
example.zh: 飯店每天早上都提供乾淨的毛巾。

extra_vocab.en: a person who is just starting to learn something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於課程、訓練、使用手冊和軟體廣告，如 beginner level（初級）。也可放在名詞前當修飾語，如 beginner course。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: beginner 是可數名詞：a beginner、beginners；放在名詞前當修飾語時用單數，如 a beginner course，不加 s。

example.en: The class is open to beginners and experienced users.
example.zh: 這堂課開放給初學者和有經驗的使用者。

example.en: You do not need experience; complete beginners are welcome.
example.zh: 不需要經驗，完全的新手也歡迎。

example.en: She wrote a beginner's guide to online marketing.
example.zh: 她寫了一本網路行銷的新手指南。

example.en: We offer courses at beginner level and advanced level.
example.zh: 我們提供初級和高級程度的課程。

example.en: This software is easy to use for beginners.
example.zh: 這套軟體對初學者來說很容易使用。

examples.en: I am a beginner, so please explain each step slowly.
examples.zh: 我是新手，所以請慢慢說明每個步驟。

examples.en: The new beginner course starts next Monday at nine.
examples.zh: 新的初級課程下週一九點開始。

examples.en: Even a beginner can learn this system in one day.
examples.zh: 就連新手也能在一天內學會這個系統。

similar.diff: novice 較正式，常用在比賽或專業領域，如 novice player；beginner 較通用。

example.en: The contest has separate prizes for novice and expert players.
example.zh: 這場比賽為新手和專家選手設有不同的獎項。

similar.diff: newcomer 指新加入或新來的人，不一定是不懂的人；beginner 強調剛開始學。

example.en: The newcomer quickly learned how to use the system.
example.zh: 這位新來的同事很快就學會了使用系統。

example.en: The expert answered questions about tax rules.
example.zh: 專家回答了有關稅務規定的問題。

example.en: Each trainee receives a guide on the first day.
example.zh: 每位受訓者在第一天都會拿到一本指南。

example.en: We offer an advanced course for experienced staff.
example.zh: 我們為有經驗的員工提供進階課程。

derived.link: begin 是詞幹；加 -ner（n 要重複）變成「剛開始學的人」，像 learner、worker

extra_vocab.note: 比 drink 正式，常見於餐廳菜單、活動公告、機上服務和飯店；food and beverage 是「餐飲業」的常用說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: beverage 是可數名詞（a beverage、beverages）；但 food and beverage 當產業名稱時，beverage 不加 s。

example.en: Hot and cold beverages are available in the lobby.
example.zh: 大廳提供熱飲和冷飲。

example.en: She manages the food and beverage department at the hotel.
example.zh: 她負責管理飯店的餐飲部門。

example.en: Please check the beverage menu for today's special drinks.
example.zh: 請看飲料單了解今天的特別飲品。

example.en: Alcoholic beverages are not allowed in the office.
example.zh: 辦公室內不允許飲用含酒精飲料。

example.en: The airline stopped its free beverage service on short flights.
example.zh: 這家航空公司在短程航班停止了免費飲料服務。

examples.en: Snacks and beverages will be served after the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議結束後會提供點心和飲料。

examples.en: Every lunch set comes with a free beverage.
examples.zh: 每份午餐套餐都附一杯免費飲料。

examples.en: We ordered more beverages for the company party.
examples.zh: 我們為公司派對多訂了一些飲料。

similar.diff: drink 是日常最常用的說法；beverage 比較正式，常見於菜單和公告。

example.en: Would you like a drink before the presentation begins?
example.zh: 簡報開始前，您想來杯飲料嗎？

similar.diff: refreshments 指活動提供的飲料加點心，常用複數；beverage 只指飲料。

example.en: Refreshments will be served in the hall at noon.
example.zh: 中午會在大廳提供茶點。

example.en: The menu changes every season at this restaurant.
example.zh: 這家餐廳的菜單每季都會更換。

example.en: The office provides free snacks on Friday afternoons.
example.zh: 辦公室在週五下午提供免費點心。

example.en: Most employees eat lunch in the company cafeteria.
example.zh: 大多數員工在公司餐廳吃午餐。

extra_vocab.en: the day each year when you celebrate the day you were born
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室慶生、會員生日優惠、賀卡和活動通知。語氣輕鬆、友善。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在生日當天」用介系詞 on：on your birthday，不用 in 或 at。

example.en: We celebrate staff birthdays on the first Friday of each month.
example.zh: 我們在每個月第一個週五為員工慶生。

example.en: Her coworkers planned a birthday party in the break room.
example.zh: 她的同事在休息室籌劃了一場生日派對。

example.en: Everyone signed the birthday card for our manager.
example.zh: 大家都在我們經理的生日卡片上簽了名。

example.en: Members receive a free birthday gift from the store.
example.zh: 會員可以從店裡領到一份免費的生日禮物。

example.en: You will get a ten percent discount on your birthday.
example.zh: 你在生日當天可以享有九折優惠。

examples.en: Please join us for cake to celebrate Tom's birthday.
examples.zh: 請來和我們一起吃蛋糕，慶祝湯姆的生日。

examples.en: Show your ID to get a free dessert for your birthday.
examples.zh: 出示證件，就能在生日時獲得一份免費甜點。

examples.en: Tomorrow is the director's birthday, so we bought flowers.
examples.zh: 明天是主任的生日，所以我們買了花。

confusable.diff: anniversary 是事件的「週年紀念日」，如公司成立週年；birthday 是人出生的日子。

example.en: The company will hold a party for its tenth anniversary.
example.zh: 公司將為成立十週年舉辦派對。

example.en: We will celebrate the new contract with a team lunch.
example.zh: 我們將以團隊午餐來慶祝新合約。

example.en: Each guest received a small gift at the event.
example.zh: 每位賓客在活動中都收到一份小禮物。

example.en: Over one hundred guests attended the opening party.
example.zh: 超過一百位賓客參加了開幕派對。
